ValidationRule.description: This is the validation, when Apple Case - 'Dispute' type is closed : Transaction Details, Closure Reason are mandatory
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: TEXT(Type) = 'Apple Pay' && TEXT(Sub_Type__c) = 'Dispute' && OR ( ISBLANK( SEID__c) , ISBLANK(TEXT(Apple_Pay_Closure_Reason__c )), ISBLANK(Transaction_Amount__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Transaction_Currency__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Transaction_Type__c)), ISBLANK( Token_Unique_Reference__c)) && TEXT( Status ) = 'Closed'
ValidationRule.errorMessage: 'SEID', 'Transaction Amount', 'Transaction Currency', 'Transaction Type', Token Unique Reference' and 'Closure Reason' are mandatory while Closing the 'Dispute' case.
